name: Noodle Kugel
steps: Mix cooled noodles, sour cream, and cottage cheese together in a bowl
Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla in separate bowl
Add eggs, sugar, and vanilla to the noodle mixture, stir until combined
Melt 4 tbsp of butter in each pan, make sure sides and bottom of pans are coated with butter
Pour excess melted butter into mixture
Equally divide mixture into the pans
Pour 1 cup milk into each filled pan
On the next day, preheat oven to 350f (180c)
Sprinkle top of each pan with 1/4 cup of cornflake crumbs, 1 tsp cinnamon sugar, and little bits of butter
Bake approx. 30 minutes covered with foil
Remove foil and bake for 1 hour, until golden and set
Remove from oven and let stand for 30 minutes to allow for easy cutting; ENJOY
